name: Jack-up rig / self-elevating unit
description: Mobile buoyant hull with movable legs jacked to the seabed; hull raised above waves for drilling, workover, production or wind-turbine service. Primary source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackup_rig

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Jackup rig: typically used in water depths up to 120 m (390 ft), some designs to 170 m
Wikipedia Jackup rig: premium/ultra-premium jackups 150-190 m (490-620 ft)

specifications.metric: tallest jackup leg length, Noble Lloyd Noble
specifications.basis: Wikipedia Jackup rig: completed 2016, legs 214 m (702 ft) tall

specifications.value: about 540 jackup drilling rigs in operation at end 2013
3 or 4 legs typical; also 6 and 8 movable legs

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Jackup rig, Process of operation
specifications.value: hull weight + ballast water drive legs into seabed before jacking hull to air gap; rack-and-pinion jacking driven by hydraulic/electric motors

applications: Mobile buoyant hull with movable legs jacked to the seabed; hull raised above waves for drilling, workover, production or wind-turbine service.
